profile.headline: Founder at Fix8 Studio | AI Dev Tools | CI/CD | Python - C# - TypeScript | Solo Developing Rad Survival
profile.summary:
Portfolio: https://nathanialmartin.com

Solo developing Rad Survival a nuclear apocalypse themed Idle RPG for browser and Steam
https://www.rad-survival.com/

I'm a CS senior at SUNY Albany with a deep interest in tools and systems development.

I'm drawn to roles where I can work with the systems that make development happen: CI/CD Pipelines, Data and Log integrations, Building the engine behind the service. I'm currently looking for entry-level positions at companies where that kind of work is valued.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern | Observability
positions.description:
Engineered an all-in-one CLI tool housing API-driven scripts for automated data extraction and reporting across two Dynatrace environments of 400+ applications and 1,000+ host machines.

Built a custom Dynatrace-ServiceNow integration, automating ticket creation for 100+ AI-detected problems weekly and consolidating alerts from multiple monitoring tools into a single platform.

Developed dashboards delivering key metrics across 30+ management zones, 400+ applications, and 200+ synthetic monitors spanning Kubernetes, AWS, and bare-metal infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · Data Analysis

company.name: NYS Office of Information Technology Services

positions.title: C# Unity Programmer
positions.description:
Built validation and automation features in C# for several proprietary Unity editor tools, enforcing unique IDs/titles and auto-generating creation-time and ownership metadata, reducing manual data-entry errors for the design and engineering teams.

Streamlined the art-asset pipeline for proprietary Unity editor tools by consolidating 3 asset folders into 1 and removing 20,000+ lines of unused JSON, improving asset clarity and structure for the art and design teams.

Collaborated in daily stand-ups with small teams of 6-10 peers for sprint planning to refine backlog items, translating complex design requirements into actionable Jira sub-tasks for efficient C# implementation.
positions.insights: Skills: Gameplay Programming · Unity · C# · Custom Tool Development · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Managed an active inventory of 500+ listings across eBay, maintaining a 100% customer satisfaction rating and consistent daily listing output through strategic use of draft banks.

Sourced used and new clothing from various channels, evaluating purchases against profit margin and sell-through rate targets to drive profitability.

Conducted market research using eBay analytics tools to identify product trends and price competitively, informing purchasing decisions and maximizing margins.

Handled all customer communications including shipping, returns, and pricing disputes, sustaining a perfect satisfaction record throughout full-time operation.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Inventory Management · Custom Tool Development · Statistical Data Analysis

positions.title: Inventory Control Clerk
positions.locationName: Albany, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:

Lead the introduction of our inventory tracking software

Analyzed inventory tracking data to determine usage and cost changes and
variations between departments

positions.title: Warehouse Associate

This was a 24 hour hackathon entry that I will continue work on

projects.title: SyllaScribe
projects.description: Web Application that utilizes Gemini AI to automatically parse a student syllabus and create a to-do list grade and assignment breakdown, allowing for grade analysis and look-ahead calculations.
